description:
InstaPrime 0.0.20 includes 177 patches for stock Instagram 454.0.0.54.77, based on HushGram and subsequent upstream changes.

### Changes

- **Messages:** configurable single-tap actions and reactions, hide or move message actions into More, independent DM Settings and Compose controls, reaction positioning fixes, and better alignment between message menus and More. Inbox holds use the styled native popup near the held row instead of the preview overlay, with a native fallback.
- **Appearance:** shared popup and dialog styling, slightly raised popup/snackbar surfaces, accent splash and status-bar improvements, and cleaner saved-profile cards with one bounded ripple. Profile actions live in the extra menu with icons.
- **Settings:** related untitled sections across crowded categories, optional Enable all controls, restart indicators on switches, and bounded dialog scrolling that keeps titles and buttons reachable.
- **Navigation:** restore the last-used tab when resuming the app; add an optional Settings shortcut before Compose in the DM header.
- **Maintenance:** updated deprecated calls in touched code and expanded focused native-hook and UI regression coverage.

### Validation and remaining issues

The existing build passed the focused native-hook and UI checks; two native cases were skipped. The MPP and SBOM are attached with SHA-256 checksums and build information. A full device walkthrough and the full upstream test gate were not performed for this release.

The message-options/reaction-tray gap still needs investigation. Empty composer + auto-hide remains deferred. Keep in Chat changes display behavior but does not archive media permanently: media can become unavailable after restarting or updating while placeholders remain. Durable local retention is deferred.

### Install

Use Android 9 or newer, Morphe Manager 2.5.0 or newer, and a matching stock Instagram 454.0.0.54.77 APK. Refresh the InstaPrime source or import the attached MPP.

Core patches and upstream maintenance are by SysAdminDoc and HushGram contributors.
Original project: https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushGram
